input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/generate_outputs.py
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+df = duckdb.connect().execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           sum(number_of_motorist_killed)::INTEGER AS motorist_deaths,
+           sum(number_of_cyclist_killed)::INTEGER AS cyclist_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).df()
+
+plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
+colors = {"motorist": "#2b6cb0", "cyclist": "#dd6b20"}
+
+# Option 1: annual fatality counts as a time-series line chart.
+values = df.copy()
+values.to_csv("out/values_1.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
+ax.plot(values.year, values.motorist_deaths, marker="o", linewidth=2.2,
+        color=colors["motorist"], label="Motorists killed")
+ax.plot(values.year, values.cyclist_deaths, marker="o", linewidth=2.2,
+        color=colors["cyclist"], label="Cyclists killed")
+ax.set(title="Motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025",
+       xlabel="Year", ylabel="People killed (count)")
+ax.set_xticks(values.year)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.legend(frameon=False)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig("out/option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 2: same annual counts in paired bars to emphasize each year's gap.
+values = df.copy()
+values.to_csv("out/values_2.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
+x = range(len(values))
+width = 0.38
+ax.bar([i - width / 2 for i in x], values.motorist_deaths, width,
+       color=colors["motorist"], label="Motorists killed")
+ax.bar([i + width / 2 for i in x], values.cyclist_deaths, width,
+       color=colors["cyclist"], label="Cyclists killed")
+ax.set(title="Annual motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025",
+       xlabel="Year", ylabel="People killed (count)")
+ax.set_xticks(list(x), values.year.astype(str), rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.legend(frameon=False)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig("out/option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 3: cyclist deaths as a percentage of the motorist death count.
+values = df.copy()
+values["cyclist_deaths_per_100_motorist_deaths"] = (
+    values.cyclist_deaths / values.motorist_deaths * 100
+).round(1)
+values.to_csv("out/values_3.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
+ax.plot(values.year, values.cyclist_deaths_per_100_motorist_deaths,
+        marker="o", linewidth=2.2, color="#6b46c1")
+ax.set(title="Cyclist deaths relative to motorist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025",
+       xlabel="Year", ylabel="Cyclist deaths per 100 motorist deaths")
+ax.set_xticks(values.year)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig("out/option_3.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print(df.to_string(index=False))
+print(values[["year", "cyclist_deaths_per_100_motorist_deaths"]].to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
